subject: Geopolitics
title: The Nuclear Ban Treaty
description: A fast breakdown of The Nuclear Ban Treaty for builders.

hook.text: In 2017, 122 nations voted to ban nuclear weapons entirely. Not a single nuclear state signed. The ban exists on paper.

buildup.text: The Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons declares all nuclear weapons illegal under international law.

discovery.text: Supporters argue it builds a moral norm. Even unsigned, it stigmatizes nuclear weapons and pressures holdouts.

twist.text: Nuclear states dismiss it as wishful thinking. Without their participation, the treaty changes nothing on the ground.

climax.text: The ban treaty shows the gap between what the world wants and what nuclear powers will accept. Dreams vs reality.

punchline.text: You can ban what you don't own. Owners disagree.

quiz.question: Why hasn't the Nuclear Ban Treaty changed nuclear arsenals?
options: It was never ratified by enough countries
No nuclear-armed state has signed it
The UN revoked the treaty after objections
